The Quick Start Guide provides step by step instructions detailing how to plug
in, and set up the AD-TRXBOOST1-EBZ board. The
ZC706 and AD-FMCOMMS3-EBZ platforms
will be used to demonstrate the appropriate board and cable connections.

The TRXBOOST1-EBZ has four SMA connectors (TX_IN, RX_OUT, TX_OUT, RX_IN). 2
male to male SMA connectors are required to connect the TRXBOOST1-EBZ board
to the FMCOMMS3 platform.

The AD-TRXBOOST1-EBZ is an add-on board for the
AD-FMCOMMS2/3/4/5 platform. It adds a pre-amp to the TX
output and an LNA to the RX input of the AD9361.

![](https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/analogdevicesinc/system-level/wiki_migration/ad-trxboost1-ebz_landing/docs/solutions/reference-desig

- 30MHz to 6 GHz
- Fixed gain of 18.4dB
- Noise figure: 2.2dB at 900MHz
- OIP3: 38.8dBm at 900MHz
- P1dB: 20.4dBm at 900MHz
- Single 5V supply

- 400MHz to 4GHz
- Fixed gain of 20.8dB at 900MHz
- Noise figure: 0.8dB at 900MHz
- OIP3: 37.0dBm at 900MHz
- P1dB: 21.8dBm at 900MHz
- Single supply between 3V and 5V

Power supply is brought to the AD-TRXBOOST1-EBZ through a 3 pin cable. The
connection is made at P2 (pin1 = 3.3V, pin2 = GND, pin3 = 12V), which sits
directly between TX_IN and RX_OUT.

The power originates from the FMCOMMS3 board, connector P301. It can also come
from an external power supply.
